_note: Candidate registry for South Dakota 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (South Dakota Secretary of State, Voter Information Portal, 2026 General Election Candidate List, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: South Dakota Secretary of State, Voter Information Portal, 2026 General Election Candidate List (https://vip.sdsos.gov/CandidateList.aspx?eid=774); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
